state.description: Client companies of the partner account, keyed by company id (read-only through the API).
Employee earning rates keyed by earning rate id.
Employees keyed by employee id; only the last four SSN digits are stored.
Row `counters` (id counter), row `limits` (optional `maxRows` scan bound) and row `tax_table` (synthetic flat tax rates).
Company pay schedules keyed by pay schedule id.
Payroll items keyed by item id; earning amounts stored, taxes and net pay computed on read.
Payrolls keyed by payroll id; stored_status draft|pending, paid/processing derived from virtual time.
Company workplaces keyed by workplace id.

operations.description: Retrieve a company (GET /companies/{company}).
List companies the API key can reach (GET /companies); `active` defaults to true; adds virtual `server_time`.
Create an hourly, annual or piece earning rate for an employee (POST /earning_rates).
List earning rates in creation order (GET /earning_rates).
Update an earning rate's name, active flag or metadata; amount and period are immutable (PATCH /earning_rates/{earning_rate}).
Create an employee (POST /employees); an SSN keeps only its last four digits.
Retrieve an employee with computed onboarding state (GET /employees/{employee}).
List employees sorted by last name (GET /employees); filters company, workplace (comma list), active, id.
Update an employee, including termination (PATCH /employees/{employee}).
Create a pay schedule (POST /pay_schedules).
List pay schedules (GET /pay_schedules).
List a pay schedule's paydays, periods and approval deadlines between start and end (GET /pay_schedules/{pay_schedule}/paydays).
Add one employee's earnings and reimbursements to a draft payroll; clears its preview (POST /payroll_items).
Delete a payroll item from a draft payroll; clears its preview (DELETE /payroll_items/{payroll_item}).
List payroll items with computed taxes and net pay (GET /payroll_items).
Update a payroll item on a draft payroll; arrays are replaced whole and the preview is cleared (PATCH /payroll_items/{payroll_item}).
Approve a previewed draft payroll before its approval deadline (POST /payrolls/{payroll}/approve).
Create a draft regular or off-cycle payroll, optionally with items (POST /payrolls).
Delete a draft payroll and its items (DELETE /payrolls/{payroll}).
Retrieve a payroll with computed totals (GET /payrolls/{payroll}).
List payrolls by payday, newest first (GET /payrolls); status is derived from virtual time.
Preview a draft payroll: validate items, compute taxes and net pay, record the preview (GET /payrolls/{payroll}/preview).
Return an approved payroll to draft before its reopen deadline (POST /payrolls/{payroll}/reopen).
Create a workplace with a US address in a supported state (POST /workplaces).
List workplaces (GET /workplaces), optionally for one company.

connections.title: Check REST API subset (sandbox partner account) served by this Tool
connections.instructions: Pass these to your test process only. Send `Authorization: Bearer <CHECK_API_KEY>` to CHECK_API_BASE_URL + /companies, /employees, /payrolls and the other implemented paths (no version prefix). The token is compared exactly with the world's HTTP token; company scope and read-only access come from actor attributes.
